no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA was not taken to FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for the class, and there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the ExEm Foam Kit (NDA212279). The Multidiscipline Review's Section 9 states the application was not taken to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant unexpected safety or efficacy issues for the class and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
